raw_response: {"diagnosis":"All 377 rows with source_tz='UTC' are in batch 13, and their txn_ts values are UTC, while the rest of the data is America/Chicago local time. Batch 13 rows between 00:00 and 04:59 UTC are really late evening of 2026-01-17 in Chicago, so they land on 2026-01-18 at 00:00-06:00. That also gives them the wrong txn_date. The fix is to convert UTC rows to Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January) in silver_transactions.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
